children: SmartKem said Jonathan Warkins, the company's chief operating officer, resigned from his post effective Aug. 31.

The resignation wasn't the result of any dispute or disagreement with the company on any matters relating to financial statements, internal controls, operations, policies, or practices, SmartKem said Friday.
Warkins was named as COO of SmartKem in March 2025. Prior to that, he had served as a consultant to the company, starting in July 2024.
The electronic transistor company's shares touched an all-time low of $2.24 on Friday. Year to date, the shares are down about 96%.
In August, SmartKem carried out a 50-to-1 reverse stock split.
